description: Android GUI proxy utility (Empowered by sing-box)

latest_release.name: v2.0.7
latest_release.body:
* Add Service check **1**
* Add Route path lookup to routing profiles **2**
* Add priority tiers and learning from real connections to the Auto Selector **3**
* Add hop-by-hop chain testing and allow an Auto Selector as a chain hop
* Add profile pinning
* Add QR code sharing for multiple profiles
* Add QUIC Opener **4**
* Add TLS fragmentation for WARP registration
* Add basic subscription filters
* Allow multiple DNS servers, queried together
* Use MTU 1280 for WireGuard files without an MTU
* Improve XHTTP and Clash import compatibility
* Update sing-box and Xray
* Fix subscription traffic not showing without a total
* Fixes and Improvements

**1**:
Checks which AI, streaming and social services work through a profile and what kind of IP it exits from.

**2**:
Shows which rule and outbound an app, domain or IP would take.

**3**:
With Choose set to In priority order, the selector stays on the highest tier that has a working profile, e.g. a preferred group first and another as fallback.

**4**:
Helps HTTP/3 profiles (MASQUE, Hysteria2, TUIC) on networks that block QUIC by its first packet.

# Throne for Android **Android proxy client, powered by [sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box)** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid?style=flat-square&label=release&color=2F80ED)](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/total?style=flat-square&logo=github&label=downloads)](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid?style=flat-square&logo=github&label=stars)](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/stargazers) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid?style=flat-square&color=6E7781)](LICENSE) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-@ThroneProj-26A5E4?style=flat-square&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/ThroneProj)
Throne for Android manages proxy profiles and subscriptions, routes traffic with rule-based routing profiles, and works either as a VPN or as a proxy-only service. It shares [Throne](https://github.com/throneproj/Throne) desktop's core and data model, so profiles, share links, route profiles and `.thrbackup` backups move freely between the two. See the [documentation](https://throneproj.github.io) for guides.

## Installation APKs for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 are on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/throneproj/ThroneForAndroid/releases), with a `SHA256SUMS` file to verify them. Throne runs on Android 7.0 (API 24) or newer, including Android TV. ### Upgrading from 1.x Releases from v2.0.0 on are signed with a new key, so Android refuses to install them over a 1.x release (signature conflict). Uninstall the old release first, then import your subscriptions and profiles again: old local configurations are not migrated. ## Supported protocols - SOCKS - HTTP(S) - Shadowsocks - Trojan - VMess - VLESS - TUIC - Hysteria - Hysteria2 - AnyTLS - Mieru - Snell - NaïveProxy - Juicity - TrustTunnel - ShadowTLS - Wireguard - AmneziaWG - MASQUE - SSH - DNSTT / VayDNS - MasterDNS - Xray VLESS (XHTTP/XDrive) - OpenVPN/OpenConnect - Custom Outbound (Both Sing-box and Xray) - Custom Config (Both Sing-box and Xray) - Chaining outbounds ## Subscription Formats Various formats are supported, including share links, various JSON representation of Sing-box configs, and v2rayN link format as well as limited support for Shadowsocks and Clash formats. Deeplinks are also supported, read the [documentation](https://throneproj.github.io/advanced/deeplinks/) for more information. ## Credits - [SagerNet/sing-box](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box) - [XTLS/Xray-core](https://github.com/xtls/xray-core) - [SagerNet/sing-box-dashboard](https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box-dashboard) - [MatsuriDayo/NekoBoxForAndroid](https://github.com/MatsuriDayo/NekoBoxForAndroid) - [SagerNet/SagerNet](https://github.com/SagerNet/SagerNet) - [shadowsocks/shadowsocks-android](https://github.com/shadowsocks/shadowsocks-android) ## Supporting Throne If Throne is useful to you, you can support its development through [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Mahdi-zarei) or with a crypto donation to one of these addresses: | Coin | Network | Address | |:--|:--|:--| | **USDT** · **TRX** | TRON (TRC20) | `THR2gbWMaTZh8ACk3VYAAyNRVffvdTRikj` | | **USDT** · **USDC** | BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) · Ethereum (ERC20) | `0x7c2dF1867f5AaEE807a835fB3c55E4de4507888A` | | **XMR** | Monero | `4AYwwN8qMQCSUb3XfwzfrLNPMHfDme6U7CmNtQY4idCF8GtHHLG68VA3iZK867ypuKFr8J7CjXiJ96eFUA2T6aLVRUbgY3A` |
